title: Ao ghazi hamari nusrat ko
body:
Ao Ghazi hamari nusrat ko
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
Deraha hai sada ye Sara ghar
Ao Ghazi hamari nusrat ko
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tere Marne se ay mere Ghazi
Hogae dar badar ye shahzadi
Chini aada ne hai meri chadar
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Run me akbar gaya tha JAB ladne
Dekhte jao mujh ko mud mud ke
Kehrahe thae jawab se ye sarwar
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ali Akbar ne khaye Hi barchi
Sona Akbar ka hogaya chalni
Tha xayefi me dagh ye dil per
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jab gala kat raha tha bhai ka
Maine dekha tha ghaur se Bhaiya
Ek tera Hi nam tha lab per
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hum ko darbar me bhi jana hai
Wada bhai se tha nibhana hai
Sar khule kaise jayegi khwahar
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hai bachi tadap ke roti hai
Jagti Hi wo aur na soti hai
Shimr ke taaziyane khaane per
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hum to dar dar phiraye jaate hain
Roye to taaziyane khaate hain
Zulm uthaye har ek manzil per
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hashmi JAB gala kata sheh ka
Qaak udati thi dast me zahra
Qun rulata hai qun bhara manzar
Roke kehti thi zainabe muztar
